free_text.inst.v2.D8: I read it twice to be sure I wasn't missing anything, and there's two or three places where it looks like something was supposed to be and there's nothing there. You got my daddy backwards. Ira was gone before I could walk and my grandparents raised me in Abbott, so if the chart's carrying good news about fathers and inheritance it was talking about somebody else. I never inherited a thing but a guitar, a work ethic and a Bohemian polka band. And it's got income and friends down as the hard part of my life - well, my friends are the best thing that ever happened to me, Paul English drove my bus and carried my money for fifty years, and the money's been just fine except the stretch the government was holding it. Where it got close was my mother and the marriages. Mama left when I was about six months old and I've been married four times, so that's fair. My sister comes out well in there too, and that's the truest line in it, though I lost Bobbie in '22. Mostly it reads like it would fit anybody who'd sit still long enough to hear it, and it says so itself, which I respect. No hard feelings. Come see the show.

notes: Answered as Willie Nelson (b. 29/30 April 1933, Abbott, Texas; alive, 93), from the documented record: abandoned by both parents in infancy and raised by grandparents; Abbott High 1950, Air Force nine months discharged for back trouble, Baylor dropped out; a decade as an unstarred Nashville songwriter, then the Austin/outlaw break and Red Headed Stranger; four marriages, eight children, Billy's death in 1991; the 1990 IRS seizure; emphysema and the lung collapse of 1981; Bobbie's death in 2022; Rock and Roll Hall of Fame 2023. The reading pulled hardest at four places and I answered against it every time. (1) It calls father and inheritance UNUSUALLY FAVOURABLE - the single most specific claim it makes - and Willie's father left him at six months and he inherited nothing, so A10=absent, A22=none, C6=opt1 and C11=opt1 all contradict it. (2) It calls income, gains and friends unusually AFFLICTED; his income has been enormous and continuous for fifty years and his friendships (Waylon, Cash, Kris, Merle, Paul English, the Family band) are among the great successes of the life, so C8=opt2 and C10=opt2. (3) It says 'right now the method reads a strong stretch', which pushes A36 toward better - I felt that pull and checked it against the life instead: the six years before mid-2023 held the pandemic touring shutdown and Bobbie's death, and since then came the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, four albums and a return to the road against 2024's illness, so 'better' stands on the biography, not on the reading. (4) It calls 'work and standing' favourable and 'marriage and partnerships' hard, which happen to match (C2=opt1 conf 5, A27=mixed); those were already the answers before I read it. Genuine coin tosses flagged low: C1 schooling (2), C10 partnership (2, collaborations superb vs three divorces), C12 sudden money (2). A4/A5 are deliberately conservative counts of clearly documented admissions and surgery rather than the likely true totals; B6 omits mother_death because I could not date Myrle's death confidently and would not guess it.
